name: San Luis Obispo County, California (United States)
description: White field charged at the centre with the county seal, with the date 1850 and the motto Not For Ourselves Alone.
history: San Luis Obispo County is a county on the Central Coast of California. The flag was adopted on 18 June 2022 (according to Flags of the World; the seal on it dates from 2016).

features.role: county seal, with the date 1850 and the motto Not For Ourselves Alone
